headline: Fisherman's Row Surges as Passage Battle Deepens
war_summary: Since the evening edition the struggle has sharpened in Fisherman's Row and Callahan's Passage while older centres hold or cool. Fisherman's Row now counts sixteen changes in two hours and forty-six on the day about Eidolo, Dankana Post and Arcadia, with holdings at seven Colonial and two neutral and both casualty rates accelerating in the last hour. Callahan's Passage follows with eight changes in two hours and twenty-four on the day about The Crumbling Passage and The Latch, holdings at eight Warden and two neutral, with both casualty rates again accelerating. Stlican Shelf remains contested with three changes in two hours and forty-four on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost at four Warden and five Colonial, and Weathered Expanse posts four in two hours and forty-eight on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest at two Warden and seven Colonial. Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Mooring County and Nevish Line record no changes in the last two hours, though Nevish Line and Linn Mercy still show heavy casualties.
